jobs.title: Technology
jobs.description: Technology - Regulus About Technology Products Ring Series LeC2 Command & Control DART Interceptor - New Careers Contact Customer Portal Our Technology The Science of Airspace Defense Four core technologies covering the full Counter-UAS kill chain. From passive detection to kinetic interception. Core Technology 1 GNSS Spoofing Proprietary GNSS manipulation techniques that create an impenetrable defensive shield against navigation-dependent threats. Multi-Constellation Simultaneously generates falsified signals across GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou on both L1 and L2/L5 frequency bands, ensuring no navigation fallback remains available. Intelligent Interception Three operational modes provide tactical flexibility: 'Push-back' forces retreat, 'Hold Pattern' traps threats in circular orbits, and 'Static Location' triggers No-Fly Zone logic. Soft-Kill Advantage Low-power approach takes control of the drone's navigation rather than destroying it. Safe for populated areas, produces no debris, and preserves evidence for forensics. Proven Effectiveness TRL-9 certified. Verified against thousands of real-world threats in active combat zones. Selected and deployed by the US Department of Defense and other leading western defense forces. Core Technology 2 AI-Powered RF Detection Dual-layer detection combining machine learning with classical pattern recognition for unmatched accuracy. Machine Learning Engine AI algorithms analyze RF signatures in real-time, identifying even previously unknown drone models through pattern similarity analysis. Models improve continuously from field data. Classical Pattern Recognition Time-domain analysis reliably detects known protocols with extremely low false alarm rates. Particularly effective for commercial drone signatures like DJI OcuSync. Fusion Detection Combined AI and classical approaches leverage the strengths of both methods. The result: 99.99% detection with minimal false alarms and unknown threat identification. Continuous Evolution Monthly protocol library updates and quarterly AI model improvements ensure the system stays ahead of the rapidly evolving drone landscape. Core Technology 3 Precision RF Jamming Targeted datalink disruption that defeats threats beyond the reach of GNSS spoofing alone. FPV Defeat Modern FPV drones navigate visually, not by GNSS. Datalink jamming severs their video and control links, forcing loss of control regardless of navigation mode. Intelligent Targeting Jamming techniques specifically designed for drone protocols maximize effectiveness while minimizing power consumption and collateral spectral impact. Instant Response Sub-second activation time. When integrated with RF detection, jamming is automatically triggered on the correct frequency bands for each classified threat. Failsafe Exploitation When drones lose communication links, most activate failsafe protocols: hovering, landing, or returning home. The threat is neutralized without kinetic force. Core Technology 4 - Coming Soon Kinetic Interception When electronic warfare isn't enough, DART provides the final layer of defense. Hardened Targets Autonomous drones with inertial navigation don't respond to GNSS spoofing or datalink jamming. Physical interception is the only option. Intelligent Escalation Integrated into LeC2, DART automatically escalates from soft-kill to hard-kill when electronic countermeasures don't achieve the desired effect. Sensor-Fused Targeting Leverages fused data from RF detection, radar, and optical tracking for precise target acquisition. An intelligent system, not just a launcher. Guaranteed Defeat Physical interception provides absolute certainty. No protocol updates, no firmware countermeasures, no escape. The threat is eliminated. Full Kill Chain From Detection to Destruction Five stages. One integrated system. Every threat covered. 1 Detect Passive RF detection identifies and classifies the threat. 2 Track Radar and optical systems provide precise tracking data. 3 Classify AI determines drone type and optimal countermeasure. 4 Soft-Kill GNSS spoofing and datalink jamming engage the threat. 5 Hard-Kill DART kinetic interception for threats that resist EW. Platform Integration Multiple Vendors. One Screen. LeC2 ties it all together - Regulus systems and third-party vendors unified in a single operational picture. Radars EO/IR CRF Jammers Detectors Effectors See the Technology in Action. Request a demonstration or technical briefing from our engineering team. Request a Briefing Total Autonomous Drone Defeat. jobs.description: About - Regulus About Technology Products Ring Series LeC2 Command & Control DART Interceptor - New Careers Contact Customer Portal Our Story From One Spoofer to Full Counter-UAS How Regulus grew from a GNSS security breakthrough into the world's most comprehensive counter-drone solution provider. The Beginning It Started With a Simple Idea Regulus was founded with a singular insight: drones depend on GNSS. Take away their navigation, and you take away the threat. Our proprietary GNSS manipulation technology proved devastatingly effective - a low-power, software-based approach that could stop any GNSS-dependent drone without kinetic force, without debris, without collateral damage. The military noticed. Our first GNSS spoofer was deployed in active combat. It worked. Then it worked again. And again. TRL-9 certification followed. Selection by the US Department of Defense. Deployment by leading Western militaries. The Ring was born. Our Evolution Building the Full Stack Each capability was born from real operational demand. Our customers told us what they needed next. Chapter 1 GNSS Spoofing Where it all began. Combat-proven GNSS manipulation that takes control of drone navigation. Push-back, hold, or land any GNSS-dependent threat. 7 kg, 60W, 1.5 km range. The foundation of everything that followed. Chapter 2 RF Detection Operators told us: "We need to see the drone before we engage it." So we built AI-powered passive RF detection. 99.99% detection rate across 70+ protocols. No emissions. Complete stealth. Now they could detect AND defeat. Chapter 3 Datalink Jamming The battlefield evolved. FPV drones don't use GNSS - they fly by camera. GNSS spoofing can't touch them. So we added 5-band, 47dBm datalink jamming. Now we could defeat every type of drone, regardless of navigation method. Chapter 4 LeC2 Command & Control Our customers deploy multiple systems from multiple vendors. They needed one screen, one platform, one picture. LeC2 was born - integrating 13 sensor and effector types from 10 leading defense vendors into a unified C2 platform. Coming Soon Chapter 5 DART Kinetic Interceptor The final piece. When electronic warfare isn't enough, DART provides kinetic hard-kill interception. Completing the Regulus kill chain from detection to destruction. Full spectrum Counter-UAS. Learn more → Integration Ecosystem Multiple Vendors - One Platform. LeC2 integrates the best-of-breed defense technologies. No vendor lock-in. Radars EO/IR CRF Jammers Detectors Effectors What Drives Us Our Principles Combat First Every product is validated by operational reality. TRL-9 is our standard, not our aspiration. We don't ship features that fail in the field. Full Kill Chain Ownership We don't make one piece of the puzzle. We own the entire Counter-UAS kill chain - detect, track, classify, soft-kill, and hard-kill. Open Integration The best defense uses the best technology, regardless of vendor. Our C2 platform integrates 10+ third-party systems because mission success demands it. Continuous Evolution The drone threat evolves daily. So do we. AI models improve quarterly, protocol libraries update monthly, and new capabilities ship continuously. By the Numbers Proven Track Record +0 Systems Delivered TRL-0 Combat Proven +0 Global Deployments Thousands Drones Defeated 0° Coverage Support World-Class Service Training Programs Comprehensive operator and maintenance training for all systems. On-site and remote options available worldwide. 24/7 Technical Support Round-the-clock assistance with dedicated support engineers assigned to each deployment. Continuous Updates Firmware, threat libraries, and AI models updated continuously through secure channels. Integration Engineering Tailored configurations and integration support for complex multi-vendor environments. Total Autonomous Drone Defeat. From detection to destruction.
